svg.aria-label: FY Merkez — One hub for every app's licences, customers and cash. The panel and server behind all the apps: Gmail sign-in, 15-day trials, one-device licences and cloned-session detection; payments in cash, M-Paisa or HesabPay; a cash desk and a map of customers by city.
